name: 65661 · Greenfield, MO
findings: ZIP 65661 (Greenfield) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (67% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 65661 (Greenfield) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 65661 (Greenfield) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).
